Dark Architecture Diagram skill v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces professional, dark-themed SVG architecture diagrams following a strict "cyberpunk-engineering" design system.
- Supports layer-based visualizations, component mapping, numbered steps, and flow arrows, all styled for high contrast and clarity.
- Defines consistent color tokens, typography rules (JetBrains Mono), and component patterns for cohesive diagrams.
- Outputs diagrams as standalone HTML files with fully embedded styles and responsive SVG viewBox.
- Provides detailed guidance on layer color usage, summary cards, LLM zones, and UI conventions for technical diagramming needs.
